answer.rationale: Rollback is disallowed by compliance, so memory_b1’s usual fix is unavailable. Circuit breaking (memory_b4) fails fast and would drop settlement writes, violating the no-lost-writes objective. The coincident peak write load and 5x write-path p99 point to saturation, which memory_b3 says headroom can absorb; failover and read-replica routing are weakly indicated (no regional signal; traffic is write-heavy, not report-read). Adding capacity is the one intervention that can restore availability without shedding customer writes. Cause is still uncertain (release efficiency vs. pure surge), so keep this a controlled capacity add, not a blind regional shift.
